items.title: Sudarshan Venu's 46% pay hike overtakes Rajiv Bajaj
items.description: TVS Motor Chairman and Managing Director Sudarshan Venu received a 46 percent pay hike to Rs 64.22 crore in FY26, overtaking Bajaj Auto’s Rajiv Bajaj, whose remuneration stood at Rs 58.87 crore as TVS outpaced Bajaj on revenue, volume and profit growth

items.title: Why is India pushing E20 petrol and why are some car-owners complaining?
items.description: India has rolled out E20 petrol nationwide ahead of schedule and is already preparing for higher ethanol blends. But motorists complain of lower mileage and engine issues. Here's what the evidence says

items.title: IHCL signs 20 new hotels and opens 11 properties in first quarter of FY27
items.description: The hospitality major now has portfolio of 645 hotels with over 66,000 keys.

items.title: Goa may restrict rental licences for Mahindra Thar after spate of accidents
items.description: Goa Transport Minister Mauvin Godinho said the proposal will be placed before the State Transport Authority after a series of accidents involving the popular SUV. Industry experts, however, caution that there is no evidence linking any specific vehicle model to a higher accident risk

items.title: India property developer K Raheja said to delay $700 million IPO
items.description: The Mumbai-based developer had been exploring an IPO that could have raised as much as $700 million, Bloomberg reported in January.

items.title: Jewellery shines brighter in Q1 FY27 despite record gold prices
items.description: Strong festive and wedding demand, rising old-gold exchanges, and continued formalisation keep organised jewellers and manufacturers on a solid growth trajectory

items.title: Meta says four US states seek $1.4 trillion in penalties over teen addiction lawsuit
items.description: Meta put forward the figure in its response to the attorneys general's filings on how penalties should be calculated if the states prevailed at trial.

items.description: The report estimates that India's aesthetic devices market, valued at around $870 million in 2026, is expected to nearly double to $1.73 billion by 2031, expanding at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of nearly 15 per cent.
